contract: assert BaseModel.model_validate accepts spaced uppercase strings and bytes under non-strict StringConstraints, normalizes them, and model_dump returns the transformed plain data
assert model_validate called with an existing model returns the same instance under the default revalidation policy
assert strip_whitespace runs before the uppercase-only pattern but to_upper runs after it, so spaced uppercase passes while spaced lowercase raises string_pattern_mismatch before conversion
assert min_length sees the stripped value while ValidationError.errors retains the original input and structured context
assert strict=True rejects bytes with string_type while accepting and normalizing an actual string
assert Annotated StringConstraints applies to each list item and ValidationError.errors reports both failures with their exact list indexes
case.goal: Use Pydantic 2.8.2 BaseModel and StringConstraints without assuming case conversion runs before pattern validation
